title: 第二十五章 终南捷径第二十六章 制灵阵液
lines: 第二十五章：终南捷径
看着慢慢平静下来的叶重，沈浩那双慈善的眼睛，炯炯有神的盯着叶重看了一会，随即有些疲惫的沉声道：“重儿，你舅舅和你舅母，已经启程前往药皇峰，去寻找你母亲的下落去了。你现在不要做任何傻事，只要你人没事就好！”。
闻言，叶重点了点头，看着沈浩那在黑发中，突然冒出的那几根清晰可见的银丝一般的白发，心中也是一震，随即乖巧的答道：“知道了外公，重儿有分寸，不会给家里乱惹麻烦的！”。
欣慰的轻轻颔首，沈浩摆了摆手，轻笑道：“像泥火候一样，快下去好好洗洗，换一身干净清爽的衣服，然后好好休息一晚。”。
一旁的沈玥闻言，也是盯着造型搞笑的叶重看了会，随即也是轻笑了起来，其脸庞之上的憔悴，也是随之消退了不少。
“看你样子是累坏了吧，今晚的事情明天再说！相信以你母亲的实力，药皇殿还留不下她，都下去吧！”，沈浩接着略带安慰的轻声道。
看着退出去的叶重与沈玥二人，沈浩沉声道：“出来吧！”。
在沈浩话音一落的刹那，只见一团影子一般的生物，从沈浩的影子中爬了出来，慢慢变厚随即充实了起来，只是那裸露在外的透明肌肤，显示着其并不是人类。
“主子，通过族人影卫的查探。潇潇那个婢女的主子，是二大少爷沈処的夫人黎凤。她是二少奶奶的人，而二少奶奶并不是黎家商行的嫡女，她是十几年前搬离天水城随即投靠药皇殿的黎家残余。其兄就是暗杀重少爷，药皇殿少殿主皇甫炎的跟班首领黎力。”。
顿了顿，那人形影子生物接着低声道：“有件事，不知道属下当说不当说！”。
瞥了一眼眼前无面无容的人形影子生物，沈浩却是大声呵斥道：“记住，你的职责是辅助我，让影族重新崛起。先辈几百年的心血，不能毁于你我之手。任何事都容不得出半点差错，所以不得隐瞒任何事，这难道你还不清楚吗？”。
“主子息怒，小的知错了！这件事是有关于，二小少爷沈宇的身份，其实沈宇并不是二大少爷沈処的血脉，而是二大少奶奶黎凤之兄黎力的儿子，是被他们假怀孕偷梁换柱了！”。
只见沈浩面容一惊，眼眸之中更是闪过一丝杀机，随即从手腕之中脱下一枚手镯，交到人形影子生物手中，沉声道：“将这手镯交到少主沈经手中，现在该是经儿挑起重担的时候了！”。
“是的，主子！”
看着慢慢变薄，如一摊水一般隐退而去的人形影子生物，沈浩低声自语道：“老二，希望你不要让我失望，祖宗的基业，可不能毁于你我之手！”。
月如银盘，漫天繁星。
独自一人洗刷好，换上母亲沈彤亲手缝制的青衫后，心神不宁难以入睡的叶重，按照往常的习惯，慢慢的攀上了自己居所的屋顶之巅。
看着满天的繁星，叶重斜躺在金色的瓦片之上，嘴中叼中一根从瓦砾间拔出的青草，微微嚼动，任由那淡淡的苦涩在嘴中弥漫开来。举起有些白皙的手掌，挡在眼前，目光透过手指缝隙，遥望着天空上那轮巨大的银月。
“唉！”，想起最近这段时间发生的事，叶重轻叹了一口气，懒懒的抽回手掌，双手枕着脑袋，眼神有些恍惚，眼眸之中更是爆发出一股猛烈的杀机。
“母亲，你一定要没事啊！”，低低的自喃声，忽然毫无边际的从少年嘴中轻吐了出来。
坐在瓦片之上，背靠着屋脊，平静的望着对面笼罩在雾气之中的险峻山峦，望着差点成为自己葬身之所的黑龙山脉，叶重也是顿感一阵唏嘘。
“呵呵，实力啊！这个世界，没有实力，只会任人欺辱，连自己都只会成为家人的拖累，更别谈守护自己心爱的人和事物了！”，肩膀轻轻的耸动，叶重那低沉的自嘲笑声，带着悲愤，带着自责，带着杀机，在山顶上缓缓的徘徊。
十指插进一头的黑发之中，叶重牙齿紧紧的咬着嘴唇，任由那淡淡的血腥在嘴角散开。虽然在大厅中，叶重并没有表现出什么不妥的过激行为。但一想到母亲因自己生死不知下落不明，却是犹如刀割在心头一般，让得叶重浑身颤粟。
“今日的心痛，我不想再受第二次！”，摊开那有着一道血痕的左手，叶重的声音，嘶哑却坚定。

Chapter 25: Shortcut to Zhongnan
Looking at Ye Chong who was slowly calming down, Shen Hao's kind eyes stared at Ye Chong for a while, and then said in a tired voice: "Zhong'er, your uncle and your aunt have already set off to Yaohuang Peak to find the whereabouts of your mother. Don't do anything stupid now, as long as you are okay!".
Hearing this, Ye Dian nodded and looked at Shen Hao's clearly visible silver-like white hair that suddenly emerged from his black hair. He was shocked in his heart and then replied obediently: "I know grandpa, Chong'er has a sense of propriety and will not cause trouble for the family!".
Nodding lightly with pleasure, Shen Hao waved his hand and said with a chuckle: "Just like Ni Huohou, go down and wash yourself, change into clean and fresh clothes, and then have a good night's rest.".
Shen Yue on the side heard this and stared at the funny-looking Ye Zhong for a while, and then chuckled, and the haggardness on his face also faded a lot.
"You look exhausted. Let's talk about tonight's matters tomorrow! I believe that with your mother's strength, Yaohuang Palace won't be able to keep her, so please go down!" Shen Hao then whispered with some comfort.
Looking at Ye Zhong and Shen Yue exiting, Shen Hao said in a deep voice: "Come out!".
The moment Shen Hao finished speaking, a shadow-like creature crawled out from Shen Hao's shadow. It slowly thickened and then became fuller. However, the exposed transparent skin showed that it was not human.
"Master, through the investigation of the clan's shadow guard. The master of Xiaoxiao's maid is Li Feng, the second young master Shen Chu's wife. She is the second young mistress, and the second young mistress is not the legitimate daughter of the Li family business. She is a remnant of the Li family who moved out of Tianshui City more than ten years ago and then took refuge in the Yaohuang Palace. Her brother is Li Li, the follower leader who assassinated Young Master Chong and Huangfu Yan, the young master of the Yaohuang Palace."
After a pause, the humanoid shadow creature then whispered: "There is something, I don't know whether I should say it or not!".
Glancing at the faceless humanoid shadow creature in front of him, Shen Hao shouted loudly: "Remember, your duty is to assist me and let the Shadow Clan rise again. The hundreds of years of hard work of our ancestors cannot be destroyed by your hands. There is no room for error in anything, so you must not hide anything. Don't you know this?"
"Master, calm down, I have realized my mistake! This matter is related to the identity of the second young master Shen Yu. In fact, Shen Yu is not the blood of the second young master Shen Chu, but the son of Li Li, the brother of the second young mistress Li Feng. They faked her pregnancy and exchanged the favor with her!"
Shen Hao's face was shocked, and a trace of murderous intent flashed in his eyes. He then took off a bracelet from his wrist, handed it to the humanoid shadow creature, and said in a deep voice: "Give this bracelet to the young master Shen Jing. Now it's time for Jing'er to shoulder the heavy burden!".
"Yes, Master!"
Looking at the humanoid shadow creature that was slowly thinning and retreating like a puddle of water, Shen Hao whispered to himself: "Second brother, I hope you won't let me down. The foundation of our ancestors cannot be destroyed by your hands!".
The moon is like a silver plate, and the sky is filled with stars.
After washing himself and putting on the green shirt handmade by his mother Shen Tong, Ye Chong, who was restless and unable to sleep, slowly climbed to the top of the roof of his residence according to his usual habit.
Looking at the stars in the sky, Ye Zhong lay on the golden tiles, holding a piece of grass pulled out from the rubble in his mouth, chewing it slightly, letting the faint bitterness spread in his mouth. He raised his somewhat fair palms to cover his eyes, looking through the gaps between his fingers at the huge silver moon in the sky.
"Alas!" Thinking of what happened recently, Ye Zhong sighed lightly, lazily withdrew his palms, rested his head on his hands, his eyes were a little dazed, and there was a fierce murderous intention in his eyes.
"Mother, you must be okay!", a low voice suddenly came out of the young man's mouth without any boundaries.
Sitting on the tiles, leaning against the ridge of the roof, calmly looking at the rugged mountains shrouded in mist across the way, looking at the Black Dragon Mountains that almost became his burial place, Ye Chong also felt a sigh of relief.
"Haha, strength! In this world, if you don't have strength, you will only be bullied by others. Even you will only become a burden to your family, let alone protect your beloved people and things!" His shoulders shook slightly, and Ye Zhong's low self-deprecating voice, filled with grief and anger, self-blame, and murderous intent, slowly wandered on the top of the mountain.
With his fingers inserted into the black hair, Ye Zhong bit his lips tightly with his teeth, letting the faint blood spread at the corners of his mouth. Although in the hall, Ye Chong did not show any inappropriate excessive behavior. But the thought of his mother's whereabouts unknown because of her life and death was like a knife cutting into his heart, making Ye Chong tremble all over.
"I don't want to suffer today's heartache again!" Ye Zhong's voice was hoarse but firm as he spread out his left hand with a bloodstain on it.
